answer: An autonomous ML deployment system is a closed loop that takes over the full cycle of model improvement. A user drops in a binary-classification CSV, declares its schema, and the system trains a proposed change on Kubernetes and promotes only candidates that beat the current champion. Accuracy improved from roughly 70% to 80% across 20 iterations. DVC versions the data, Kubeflow Pipelines runs training, MLflow holds the champion/challenger registry, and a FastAPI service rolls forward via GitOps whenever a new champion is promoted, with no human in the loop. You can read more and find the repo at https://github.com/my-neme-eh-jeff/deploying-autoresearch.
